It starts on cron 0 5 * * * (Asia/Jerusalem), on spark.
First reads the configured sections and their search queries; then claims today's issue, unless it was already delivered.
Then searches the web for each section, for each item (up to 20).
Each time, from here on, only if deliver is true, runs the section's web search, trying up to 3 times; then keeps only the results the issue may show.
Then summarises each section, for each item (up to 20).
Each time, if deliver is true and results is not {}, asks the language model for a short summary of the section's results, trying up to 2 times, carrying on even if it fails.
Then, if deliver is true, renders the issue as an email and as an EPUB; then checks the email has not been sent yet and freezes what will be sent.
Then, if send is true, sends the issue by email, trying up to 3 times, carrying on even if it fails.
Then, if deliver is true, records the sent email and checks the reader does not have the issue yet.
Then, if deliver is true and push is true, queues the EPUB on the e-reader, trying up to 3 times.
Then, if deliver is true, marks the day's issue as delivered.
Nothing continues from here.
When it is done, nothing else happens.
